answer: Each identity posts a 25 USDT slashable bond and finishes a sequential delay puzzle taking about five hours of single-thread CPU, impossible to split across machines. Bond and puzzle lock to one key, so a trellis of graded work grows behind each identity while newcomers carry no weight. A zephyr of free traffic cannot pass: every fake still pays 25 USDT plus five hours, so 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 USDT and 5,000 CPU-hours, verifiable on chain. In a tundra of unproven accounts, only graded history earns influence, and clusters sharing one funding source get flagged as one actor.
